draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.37, the 31st-best grade among 257 2024 draftees and 1st of 19 at LB. He lasted until pick 69, well after his grade rank (31st): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Willie Gay. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 95 tackles in 2023, 6th of 19 LBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 3 pro, currently with the Los Angeles Chargers (practice squad). 11 career games and 1 starts over 1 completed season. Still developing: 1 AV in 2024. Weak spots: approximate value 1 (14th percentile), tackles for loss 0 (16th percentile). Played 11 of 17 games in 2024. Versus the typical Year-1 off-ball linebacker who played: 29 combined tackles against a median of 23, above the norm.
